_readme: THE SECOND FORCES FOLD (2026-09-02). Palle: 'forces are 16 maps, can we compress them.' Ruled: Arena is the F = ma exam and stays. Measured first: the ten bench rooms hold 137 tokens and the six Acts 44, sharing only 23, so the benches are not duplicates of the Acts below rung 2 and cannot be deleted without losing artifacts. So the fold is BY RUNG: the two rung-1/2 benches become one operations bench (VFM_02), VFM_03 folds into VFM_05 on rung 3, VFM_06's springs fold into Act IVb (oscillation), VFM_04's fields fold into Act III's field half so the field idea is no longer stated at room 7 and dropped for six rooms, and the PropGallery's props fold into the Arena, the exam where forces are felt. 16 -> 11. Every token in a dropped map has a verdict below; a token already placed in a live spine room is retired as a duplicate, plumbing is retired with its description quoted, everything else is rescued into its rung's room. Check: python tools/fold_ledger.py --sequence=forces --plan=doc/folds/forces_2026-09-02.json --check
_supersedes: doc/folds/forces.json (2026-08-25), which no longer checks green because the sequence grew two rooms after it was written.
_rule: rescue when the token has NO live spine home; retire as duplicate when a live spine room already places it; retire as plumbing only when the registry description says monitor / runner / console / test.
